## Design decisions (this row's)

- **The matrix is DATA (`sig.registry-publish-matrix/1`), the lint is
  code** — a new registry field ships no verdict until a reviewed table
  row declares it (SIG-ENG-001; K10 AT-K10-02 "lint fails on a new
  unclassified field").
- **Access/auth publish via ordered substring maps, not per-row
  rewrites** — the registry's free text stays internal evidence (T =
  transform, never rendered raw); `[[access_method_map]]` /
  `[[auth_model_map]]` classify first-match onto the closed vocabularies,
  absent → `not_recorded`, unmapped → lint violation. Zero data churn.
- **`publisher_type` seeds only where I1 typed it** — the 248 uncovered
  rows stay honestly untyped; `other` is I1's recorded verdict for
  unidentified/community publishers, never a fill-in default.
- **Descriptions bind to confirmed batch rows by sha256** — the
  copy-batch convention applied per-source; a declared `description`
  whose text matches no `confirmed` row fails the lint, so drafted copy
  can never self-ship. All 590 rows stage `pending` across 24 files
  (~25 each, OD-07 a).
- **`one_time_load` flags the 42 `once (static…` rows** — an explicit
  bool instead of the emit path's cadence-text parse (which matched
  nothing today).
